title: check-platform-checklist: the line-citation limb refuses `file:NNN`, `:NNN` and an `L` pin but not the comma form `file.ts,NNN` or a tilde range `~NNN-MMM` — 42 comma citations accumulated unrefused (#24579 rounds 9–10)
body:
**Filing gate ①: a gate defect with a named location and a measured instance.** **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat. The gate's subject is the QA ledger under `docs/qa/**`, a code- and doc-quality gate that SKILL.md's lane table keeps in this lane. It takes one PR on the checklist gate's line-citation limb and its self-test. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023), on the maintainer's 「为什么要记录行号，这个最容易偏离啊」 and 「ok」 in this seat's chat. ⛔ Not a claim. The lane is self-labelled under rule B; grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## What the gate refuses today (`main` `3fbef41b4a`)

`check-platform-checklist` reports "line citations: 0 survive across 21 swept documents — `file:line`, a bare `:NNN` continuation and an `L` pin are all judged by `symbol-anchors.mjs`". The patterns behind it need a colon:
- `LINE_ANCHOR`: `(PATHISH):~?(LINE_SPEC)`, `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs:369`;
- `PATHLESS_COLON_CITATION`: `≈:448`.

## What it lets through, measured

- **The comma form, `file.ts,NNN` or `file.ts,NNN-MMM`.** #24579 round 9 (PR #24752) and round 10 (PR #24788) re-pointed 42 of them, by hand, to `file#symbol` anchors, after they had accumulated unrefused. The census of the area files now reads 0.
- **A tilde range, `~NNN-MMM`, with no colon.** `records-forms.field-type-constraints` carried `createColumn ~7354-7368` until PR #24824. Today one remains, quoted inside a history row, which is append-only.
- Nothing stops a new item from writing either form tomorrow.

The PM's census at `3fbef41b4a`, over every file under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`:

| form | pattern used | hits |
|:--|:--|:--|
| comma, tight (extension, `,`, digits; no space) | `\.(?:ts\|tsx\|mts\|mjs\|cjs\|js\|jsx\|json\|md\|mdx\|yml\|yaml\|sh),\d{1,5}(?:[-–]\d{1,5})?\b` | area files 0; `FOLLOW-UPS.md` 11 |
| comma, loose (a space allowed) | the same with `\s?` around the comma | area files 3 more. These are counts after a file name, not citations (#24579 round 9's report), so the loose form must not be the rule |
| tilde range | `~\s?\d{2,5}\s?[-–]\s?\d{2,5}` | 1, inside a `records-forms` history row |

## Wanted

- The checklist sweep refuses the tight comma form and a tilde range, beside the colon forms. The refusal names the remedy it names today: a `file#symbol` anchor, or prose.
- **Scope it to the checklist's corpus.** `symbol-anchors.mjs` is the one resolver shared by at least `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check-issue-citations`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-react-page-adapter-contract` and `doc-line-anchors`. Before widening any shared pattern, measure every one of those corpora and report its new hits. Otherwise widen the checklist's own projection only.
- **Append-only text is not judged.**
  - `history[*]` rows quote what an item used to say.
  - `FOLLOW-UPS.md` is the sweeps' decision register ("append, never rewrite"), and holds the 11 comma hits.
  
  Exempt both, or grandfather them by a measured count with a stated reason. ⛔ Never rewrite them to pass.
- **Self-test pins:**
  - `foo.ts,123` and `foo.ts,123-140` refused;
  - `~7354-7368` refused;
  - `foo.test.ts, 12 cases` (a count) and `history[1]` admitted;
  - a hit inside a `history` row, or in `FOLLOW-UPS.md`, not judged.
- ⛔ No new gate (「新增门禁默认否」): this closes a measured escape in the existing line-citation limb. Prose such as "(line 124)" stays out of scope: its spellings vary too much to refuse without false positives.

## Dedupe

The card is filed straight after #24579's rounds 9–10, the only work on this spelling. MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open and closed: "check-platform-checklist line citation comma range tilde symbol-anchors LINE_ANCHOR refuse", 23 hits. None widens the limb. The hits are #24579 itself, eight closed "check:platform-checklist is red on main" cards (#24438, #23593, #23376, …) and #23121, a clause re-point family. #24579 rounds 9–10 swept the instances and did not change the gate.

Dedupe words: comma-range line citation file.ts,NNN; tilde range ~NNN-MMM; LINE_ANCHOR colon only; checklist line-citation limb escape.
